x, y, n = map(float, input().split())

best_dif = 1e9
best_a = 0
best_b = 1

import math

for b in range(1, int(n) + 1):
    a1 = math.ceil(b * x / y)
    a2 = math.floor(b * x / y)
    diff_a2 = abs(x / y - a2 / b)
    if diff_a2 < best_dif:
        best_dif = diff_a2
        best_a = a2
        best_b = b
    diff_a1 = abs(x / y - a1 / b)
    if diff_a1 < best_dif:
        best_dif = diff_a1
        best_a = a1
        best_b = b

print(f"{int(best_a)}/{int(best_b)}")
